title: Sample 13-13: Song Title with Additional Information

illustrates.quote: Leave a blank line following the title. List the information printed between the title and the song in the following order: (1) Text centered below the title. (2) Text printed on the left side of the page. (3) Text printed on the right side of the page. Use 7-5 margins for each item; do not leave blank lines between these items. Do leave a blank line before the beginning of the first verse. (See Sample 13-13: Song Title with Additional Information on page 13-28.)
